name: rainline
description: Arcade drifting game in the rain, on Three.js and TypeScript.

scripts.build:portal: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --mode portal && cd dist-portal && zip -qrFS ../rainline-portal.zip . && cd .. && node tools/portal-check.ts
scripts.build:playgama: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --mode playgama && cd dist-playgama && zip -qrFS ../rainline-playgama.zip . && cd .. && node tools/portal-check.ts playgama
